source_claims.claim: Typed matching/partition modules; glue D:a→b and E:b→c; outer equivalence classes form the composite and closed middle classes contribute δ; identities and juxtaposition define category/tensor structure.

diagram_recommendations.diagram_kind: Two-layer typed composition diagram (Brauer matching and optionally partition variant).
diagram_recommendations.concrete_content_to_draw_or_check: Place D above E with b middle vertices identified, label outer boundaries a and c, trace a closed middle component with a δ factor and label remaining outer matching H. For partition version show outer blocks and one removed middle class. Check source order E∘D and objects a,b,c.
diagram_recommendations.editorial_note: The prose fully defines the equivalence relation and scalar. A small drawing could help readers visualize the construction; its absence is not a defect.

source_claims.claim: Basis diagrams C^t_{x,y}=x*∘y indexed by labels t and link states.
Cut propagating strands at a horizontal midpoint to obtain reflected upper link state x and lower link state y; gluing reconstructs the diagram and cellular products.

diagram_recommendations.diagram_kind: Cut-and-glue link-state decomposition of one Temperley–Lieb basis diagram.
diagram_recommendations.concrete_content_to_draw_or_check: Draw an n-to-n planar pairing with t propagating strands, cut each propagating strand at the midline, label the reflected upper half x:n→t and lower half y:n→t, then show x*∘y and indicate that fewer-than-t middle propagating strands land in J_t. Check reflection orientation and order of composition.
diagram_recommendations.editorial_note: The proof already states the inverse construction precisely. This diagram would be optional support for the bijection/cellular basis indexing.

source_claims.claim: Spin(2) is the unit circle in the even Clifford algebra; its map to SO(2) doubles the angle, and the two half-spin characters see half-angle lifts.
Spin(2)={a+bE:a²+b²=1}; conjugation sends e₁,e₂ by rotation θ for gθ=cos(θ/2)−E sin(θ/2); g₂π=−1, g₄π=1; characters on S± have opposite half-angle signs.

diagram_recommendations.diagram_kind: Circle covering map / angle-doubling diagram with lift and kernel labels.
diagram_recommendations.concrete_content_to_draw_or_check: Show Spin(2)≅S¹→SO(2)≅S¹, e^{iφ}↦rotation(2φ), with θ=2φ; mark two preimages ±gθ and kernel {±1}. Optionally show the S+ and S− character values e^{±iθ/2}; check the sign convention against E=e₁e₂ and the source formula for gθ.
diagram_recommendations.editorial_note: All maps and signs are written explicitly and visually sound. A circle diagram could clarify the covering and half-angle distinction; optional only.
